<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Cabinet infrastructure approvals:</strong> The Union Cabinet has sanctioned significant infrastructure upgrades, including the four-laning of National Highway-56 in Gujarat and three major railway multitracking projects spanning eight districts across four states.</li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission and party disputes:</strong> The Election Commission has scheduled a joint hearing for October 30 to address the ongoing leadership dispute between two rival factions of the Trinamool Congress.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
